title: Daily Devotional #65
paragraphs: Today, I read Luke 21 and was struck by the powerful words of Jesus. In this chapter, He speaks about the end times and warns His followers about the challenges that they will face in the future.

Jesus tells His disciples that there will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars, and that nations will be in turmoil. He also warns that His followers will be persecuted and brought before kings and governors because of His name.

Reading this, I can't help but think about the challenges that I face in my own life. While they may not be as severe as the ones Jesus spoke of, they can still feel overwhelming at times. But in the midst of all these difficulties, I am reminded that You are with me, just as You were with Jesus and His disciples.

Jesus tells His followers not to worry about what they will say when they are brought before their accusers, but to trust in You and to rely on Your Spirit to guide them. I pray that I too would have this kind of trust and dependence on You, especially when I face challenging situations.

As I read further, I am struck by the words of Jesus in verses 34-36: "Be careful, or your hearts will be weighed down with carousing, drunkenness and the anxieties of life, and that day will close on you suddenly like a trap. For it will come on all those who live on the face of the whole earth. Be always on the watch, and pray that you may be able to escape all that is about to happen, and that you may be able to stand before the Son of Man."

These words remind me that the most important thing in life is to stay focused on You and to be ready for the return of Jesus. I pray that I would not be weighed down by the cares of this world, but that I would be always on the watch, ready and waiting for the day when I will stand before Him.
Thank You for the words of Jesus in Luke 21. May they continue to guide and encourage me as I seek to live a life that honors You.
